other: Students are required to pass one credit of English, one credit of math, and earn the requisite number of credits during both Freshman and Sophomore years in order to be promoted.
graduation_requirements.raw_text:
The credits required to graduate are 23 as distributed below:
English 4 Math 3
Science 3 (At least 1 Life and 1 Physical)
Social Studies 4 Physical Education 1.5
Health .5 Fine Arts 1
Electives as needed to total 23
